# How to Log in to TradeLocker

There are two ways to log in to TradeLocker.

- **TradeLocker Profile:** For traders who want to connect all their broker and prop accounts in one place, switch instantly, and access a free demo anytime.
- **Broker/Prop firm credentials login:** For traders who access TradeLocker through a broker or prop firm account.

## Log in with your TradeLocker Profile

**Step 1: Go to** [app.tradelocker.com.](http://app.tradelocker.com/)

![log in to tradelocker](https://tradelocker.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Screenshot-2026-04-30-at-14.37.37.png)

**Step 2: Log in with Google or Apple.**

Select how you want to continue: with your Google or Apple account.

You’ll land directly on the platform with your demo account ready. If you have broker or prop firm accounts connected to your profile, you can switch between them from the account switcher in the top bar.

![tradelocker demo](https://tradelocker.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Screenshot-2026-04-30-at-16.24.03-scaled.png)

## Connect a broker or prop firm account

Once you are ready to enter the market, you can connect a broker or prop firm directly from your TradeLocker Profile, no need to create a new account.

Click the account box in the bottom left corner and press **+**. From there, you can:

- **Pick a Broker:** browse the [full list](https://tradelocker.com/hub/brokers) and start trading with your own funds.
- **Pick a Prop Firm:** explore challenges on the [Hub](https://tradelocker.com/hub/prop-firm-challenges) and get funded.
- **Connect Broker/Prop:** already have a broker or prop account on TradeLocker? Log in to connect it to your profile.
- **Add New Demo Account:** create an additional demo account for practice.

To **connect an existing account**, simply enter the **credentials** your broker or prop firm sent you (email, password, server). _It’s in an email you received from your broker/prop firm once you registered with them._

![switch from tradelocker demo to live](https://tradelocker.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/ScreenRecording2026-05-06at15.37.48-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif)

> Don’t have a broker/prop firm account yet? You can find a full list of compatible brokers and prop firms on the [TradeLocker Hub](https://tradelocker.com/hub).

## Log in with Broker/Prop Firm Credentials

Use this if your broker or prop firm gave you a set of trading credentials to access TradeLocker.

![log in to tradelocker](https://tradelocker.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Screenshot-2026-04-30-at-15.03.55.png)

**Step 1: Go to [app.tradelocker.com](http://app.tradelocker.com/)**

Open the platform in your browser or launch the TradeLocker mobile app.

**Step 2: Select “Log in with broker/prop”**

Choose this option on the login screen.

**Step 3: Enter your three credentials**

Your broker will have sent these by email when your account was activated:

- **Account email:** the email address registered with your broker
- **Password:** your broker account password
- **Server:** a short code that identifies your broker’s server (e.g. `TL-Live-01`)

**Step 4: Click Log in**

You’ll be taken into the platform and connected to your broker account.

## Switching between accounts after login

If you have a TradeLocker Profile with multiple accounts connected (broker accounts, prop firm accounts, and your demo), you can switch between them at any time without logging out.

Click the account switcher in the bottom left bar and select the account you want to use.

### Troubleshooting

**Wrong broker credentials**

Check the welcome email from your broker, it contains your account email, password, and server ID. If you can’t find it, contact your broker’s support team to have the credentials resent.

**Server ID not recognised**

Make sure you’re entering the server ID exactly as it appears in your broker’s email, including any dashes or capital letters. If it still doesn’t work, contact your broker to confirm the correct server.

**Can’t remember which method you used to sign up**

We recommend logging in with TradeLocker Profile. That way, every account you trade with, will be unified in one simple profile.

- Connect all your broker and prop firm accounts.
- Switch between them instantly (no more logging in and out).
- Access a **free demo trading account** for practice (no broker required).

[Set up your TradeLocker Profile](https://auth.tradelocker.com/realms/tradelocker/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=frontend-app&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.tradelocker.com%2Fen%2Ftrade&scope=openid&response_type=code&social=true&ui_locales=en&state=EHw34fBImJbDZl0C&nonce=gr2v7wmsLIxK&code_challenge=1_eeBVT2nLY557mL7rbLLHPJk-rcE7wyLQ0Am0a3R9o&code_challenge_method=S256)

Getting started with TradeLocker

Learn how to start trading with a broker or prop firm, connect an existing account, or explore demo options.

How can I start trading on TradeLocker?

It depends on whether you want to try **TradeLocker Demo** or trade with a **broker** or a **prop firm**.

First, go to [app.tradelocker.com](https://app.tradelocker.com/) and create your TradeLocker Profile. You can start trading immediately on TradeLocker Demo to explore the platform and refine your trading strategy with $100,000 in virtual funds.

Once you’re ready to enter the market, click on your profile icon > **Add account**. You will be prompted to pick a broker or prop firm or connect an existing broker or prop firm account to your Profile.

**Pick a broker**: Find a broker on [TradeLocker Hub](https://tradelocker.com/hub/brokers) and open a TradeLocker trading account on their website. Once the account is active, the broker will send you your login credentials (username, password, and server), so that you can connect it to your Profile and start trading.

**Pick a prop firm**: Sign up for a trading challenge or funded account with a [prop firm that uses TradeLocker](https://tradelocker.com/hub/prop-firms). The prop firm will provide your trading account credentials so that you can add that account to your TradeLocker Profile and begin trading on the platform.

Can I connect an existing brokerage account?

Yes. From your profile settings, select **Add account** and enter your broker or prop firm credentials. The account will appear in your account switcher alongside your demo, and you can connect multiple accounts to a single profile.

To see which brokers and prop firms are currently supported, explore [the broker list](https://tradelocker.com/hub/brokers) or [the prop firm list](https://tradelocker.com/hub/prop-firms) on TradeLocker Hub.

What if I don’t want to trade with my own funds?

You can use the built-in demo account to trade with $100,000 in virtual funds (no deposit required). The demo allows you to practice strategies, explore the interface, and get comfortable before committing real capital.

If you're looking to trade with a funded account without using your own money, TradeLocker is used by many prop firms that offer funded challenges. [Check out the full list of challenges](https://tradelocker.com/hub/prop-firm-challenges).

\*This approach means you are not risking your personal funds, but keep in mind that prop firms may charge a challenge or evaluation fee to participate.

Is TradeLocker free?

Yes, creating a TradeLocker Profile and using the TradeLocker demo account is completely free. You only need to fund an account when you [connect a live broker](https://tradelocker.com/hub/brokers) or [buy a challenge from a prop firm](https://tradelocker.com/hub/prop-firm-challenges). Even then, funding is handled directly with your broker, not through TradeLocker, meaning the access to the platform is completely free.

What can I trade on TradeLocker?

TradeLocker gives you access to a wide range of instruments including **forex pairs, crypto, indices, commodities, stocks** and more. The exact instruments available to you depend on your connected broker or prop firm.

Your TradeLocker Demo account currently offers a list of 33 instruments so you can practice on what you'll trade live.

How to get access to advanced trading tools on TradeLocker?

Some features, including alerts, trailing stop loss, and advanced reports and more, are not available on the TradeLocker Demo account.

To unlock the full suite of trading tools, you'll need to **connect a live broker or prop firm account** to your TradeLocker profile

Can I switch between TradeLocker accounts without logging out?

Yes. Use the account switcher in the bottom left corner to **move instantly** between your demo account and any connected broker or prop firm accounts. There, you can also **connect more accounts** to your Profile. **No need to log out** or re-enter credentials when switching.

What is a TradeLocker Profile and do I need a broker to create one?

A TradeLocker Profile is your personal account on the platform. It's **free** to create and gives you immediate access to demo trading with $100,000 in virtual funds (no broker or prop firm account needed to sign up).

Once you have a profile, you can **connect one or more broker or prop firm accounts** to it at any time, and switch between them all from one place without logging out.

How does TradeLocker Demo work, and how long does the demo account last?

When you create a TradeLocker Profile, a demo account is set up for you automatically with a **virtual fund balance**. You can use it to place trades, test strategies, and explore the platform on real market data, without any financial risk.

Keep in mind that some platform features are not available on TradeLocker Demo (alerts, trailing stop loss, advanced reports…).

The demo account doesn't expire and stays active even after you connect a live broker or prop firm account. You can also **add multiple demo accounts** to your Profile.

What happens to my TradeLocker demo account when I go live?

Nothing changes. Your **demo account remains active** after you connect a broker or prop firm account, and your virtual funds stay intact. They aren't transferred or affected by your live trading in any way.

You can continue using demo independently at any time alongside your live/demo accounts.

If you don't yet have an active broker or prop firm account, you can still connect one later directly from your profile.

# How do you log in to your TradeLocker account?

TradeLocker guide

Updated over 2 weeks ago

After you create an order and pay for an account with the Tradelocker platform, you can find your credentials and server in the accounts overview in your dashboard.

​

When you click on the key icon, you will be able to locate your login credentials, server name, and also the URL for the webtrader.

​

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/xi8tmbo0/1548244011/473b47c6d799bde0b3182c6cdca7/image.png?expires=1781497800&signature=35124038a304d531442d782cc9de4ceb2fd5cfa8048a73f7bd978b969578ebe7&req=dSUjHst6mYFeWPMW1HO4zWzYdRApsVkA5k%2FARXR%2BdiepY9Sv3yHgP55xhsyz%0A6mFkt3W9bj6PWxY7e4A%3D%0A)
